topic.label: Claude Code Reference
topic.desc: Claude Code reference: CLI, commands, environment variables, tools, interactive mode, checkpointing, hooks, channels and glossary.

concepts: CLI, commands and settings (Claude Code Reference): 3 documentation pages.
Tools, hooks and channels (Claude Code Reference): 3 documentation pages.
Sessions and interaction (Claude Code Reference): 2 documentation pages.
skills: Complete reference for Claude Code command-line interface, including commands and flags. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/cli-reference
Complete reference for commands available in Claude Code, including built-in commands and bundled skills. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/commands
Reference for environment variables that control Claude Code behavior. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/env-vars
Complete reference for the tools Claude Code can use, including permission requirements and per-tool behavior. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/tools-reference

Reference for Claude Code hook events, configuration schema, JSON input/output formats, exit codes, async hooks, HTTP hooks, prompt hooks, and MCP tool hooks. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks

Build an MCP server that pushes webhooks, alerts, and chat messages into a Claude Code session. Reference for the channel contract: capability declaration, notification events, reply tools, sender gating, and permission relay. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/channels-reference
Complete reference for keyboard shortcuts, input modes, and interactive features in Claude Code sessions. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/interactive-mode
Track, rewind, and summarize Claude's edits and conversation to manage session state. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/checkpointing
Definitions for Claude Code terminology. Learn what agentic loop, compaction, CLAUDE.md, hooks, subagents, MCP, and other core concepts mean. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/glossary
mcp: Anthropic's official MCP server for searching and reading the Claude Developer Platform documentation (Streamable HTTP at https://platform.claude.com/docs/mcp).

provenance.notes: Domain Claude, built from Anthropic's public documentation indexes (llms.txt) fetched on 2026-11-11: concepts are documentation sections or URL groups, skills are documentation pages (API Reference: one skill per API resource). Agents are role holders per topic, to be refined. MCP: the official Claude docs MCP server listed in platform.claude.com/docs/llms.txt; its tool names are not listed there, so none are given.
